column1: # Natural Semantic Metalanguage — the defining vocabulary.
# Every facet-value explication in terms.tsv must be writable in these words
# Wierzbicka & Goddard.  ~65 primes; the English exponents are given.  A prime
# is ONE SENSE of the listed word, not the whole word.
# --- NSM has a SYNTAX as well as a lexicon.  These carry no meaning of their
# --- own; they are how primes are combined.  Declared, not smuggled.
# --- Inflected forms.  A prime is a MEANING; its exponent inflects normally in
# --- whatever language carries it.  "someone said" is the prime SAY, not a
# --- violation.  Listed rather than stemmed, so the set stays auditable.
